title: Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for a Claude Code plugin manifest (.claude-plugin/plugin.json). Component fields carry plugin-root-relative paths beginning with './': 'commands' and 'agents' enumerate explicit markdown files so documentation files beside them are never registered as components; 'skills' names directories whose immediate children each carry a SKILL.md entry point.

displayName.description: Name shown in the UI in place of 'name'. Not used for namespacing or lookup.

version.description: SemVer version of the plugin. Pins the plugin so consumers receive updates only when it changes.

icon.description: Directory listing: plugin-root-relative path to an image file. Claude Code ignores it at load time.

documentationUrl.description: Directory listing: documentation link. Claude Code ignores it at load time.

supportUrl.description: Directory listing: support link. Claude Code ignores it at load time.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: Directory listing: privacy policy link. Claude Code ignores it at load time.

termsOfServiceUrl.description: Directory listing: terms of service link. Claude Code ignores it at load time.

description.description: Capability-led description of what the plugin provides.

commands.description: Explicit plugin-root-relative paths to command markdown files.

agents.description: Explicit plugin-root-relative paths to agent markdown files.

hooks.description: Plugin-root-relative path to a hooks.json configuration.

listingUrl.description: Anthropic's directory requires an https:// URL for each listing link.
